_help: Hand-written 'you' scripts of the built-in Hobo Bag (pipeline/ugc_script.py uses them before its generic engine: five scripts, one per angle). Only facts of docs/PLAYBOOK.md section 1 and make_batch.PRODUCTS['hobo bag']: hidden anti-theft back pocket (flat against you; passport, cards), two gold side zips (keys, phone), divided compartments (nothing sinks to the bottom), two adjustable straps (handbag / shoulder / crossbody), soft water-resistant scratch-proof leather that looks expensive and gets better with time, the offer (% and gift from the product's real offer: {off_sp} 'fifty percent off', {price_sp} 'half price', {Price_sp} 'Half price', {gift_sp} 'a free matching pouch wallet', {P} '50%', {price_label} 'HALF PRICE' (else '35% OFF'), {ship_s} 'Free US shipping too. ' in a wording that differs per script; a [..] part drops out when a value in it is empty, a line with an empty value outside [..] falls back to the engine's), 1-year warranty, easy returns, and reviews 2, 3, 6-10, 12 verbatim. Every hook flows into chapter c1 (never repeats it); hooks[0] is the main hook, the others are the alt pool (H2-H4 ...), types spread; a chapter's 'alt' wording (another sentence for the same facts) is used from seed 2 on, for every other chapter (seed + chapter index even), and the main hook rotates through the hooks list with the seed. reviews chapter: [review number, piece index into ugc_arcs.json reviews.pieces]. No first person (I, my, me) outside a review quote.
